name: Merchant Cog
text: When docked: trade 2 cargo for 3 points.

name: Lighthouse
text: Your ships may dock at night. Night actions cost 1 less.

name: Harbormaster
text: Once per round: rearrange two docked ships.

name: Storm Front
text: All undocked ships lose their cargo. Swift ships may dock first.

name: Smuggler's Sloop
text: Night: dock unseen. Worth 2 extra points if never inspected.

name: Customs House
text: Inspect a docked ship: steal 1 cargo from it.
